say:1:1610625001:1.text: Silven, Pippa, and Cassadee have already been questioned. Gervan's interrogation is being handled separately. That means next up will be Anita or Ravendi.

say:2:1610625002:1.text: No. Given the circumstances, I would like to speak with <style="highlight">Niall</style> next.

say:3:1610625003:1.text: Niall? I don't think that's a good idea. He's lost all his mana. He's extremely weak and still recovering in the infirmary.

say:4:1610625004:1.text: I only have a few questions. He may have lost his magic, but I doubt he is too weak to walk or talk.
say:4:1610625004:1.source_cn: 只是问几个问题而已，他虽然失去了魔力，但应该没虚弱到无...

say:5:1610625005:1.text: Envoy Evie, this really isn't appropriate. As acting headmaster, I must prioritize his health.
say:5:1610625005:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，这恐怕不合适……作为代理校长，我必须要对学生...

say:6:1610625006:1.text: We should wait until Niall is fully recovered...
say:6:1610625006:1.source_cn: 我们应该等尼尔彻底康复以后再……

say:7:1610625007:1.text: I insist. Surely you want him to clear his name as soon as possible, don't you, Headmistress Durella?
say:7:1610625007:1.source_cn: 不，必须现在。杜瑞拉女士，校方应该希望他能尽快洗清嫌疑吧？
